params._comment: R27 (§17.3 fork (a)): the Cell's play loop over the duck's map vocabulary -- the node is the map EPM's winner (pi_cell_size 0), the value field is the place TLE, the climb is the bearing to the most novel reachable node (wander_stall_ticks 0: the Cell's A2, so the climb engages). Its bearing sets the adapter's heading reference (sense slot 10); the heading prior turns the body. The loop the Cell dropped is the loop the duck wants: coverage is its goal.

description: R37 (the play loop HOLDS its sub-goal until reached (commit_hold) -- the operator's 'hold a trajectory longer', in the loop's terms), from a1v2_r34_h2_head_joints.json: 2026-09-11, from the operator's eye on R36 (circling in the centre, many similar nodes there; 'it needs to hold a trajectory for longer'). Measured on R34 and R36 alike: the map's current node changes 130-155 times a minute (nodes 8-13 cm apart, 23-47 cm of pose spread each), the play loop drops its committed sub-goal whenever the current node is not adjacent to it, so the target is re-chosen several times a second; the bearing to a fresh target inside the 18 cm turning radius saturates the yaw command (|vyaw| 0.95, 50 sign flips a minute) and the body orbits: 286 deg turned per metre, straightness 0.14-0.24. commit_hold: the sub-goal is held until reached or no longer uphill, and the bearing is taken from the loop's own odometry to the target, not from the flickering node's centroid. No timescale set. Judged: straightness and switch/min (new sweep columns), cells, walls/min, objs/min, down%.
